submitted.rationale: Out of 3 merit measurements, index 23 (Co0.20Sb0.80) had the highest EQE at 0.00266%. EQE rose toward the Sb-rich end, going above that of the trirutile CoSb2O6 composition (index 18). The Co-rich end gave negative EQE.

rejected.reason: At the CoSb2O6 trirutile composition, EQE was only 0.00084%, below index 23.
This Co-rich spinel-like composition gave negative EQE (-0.0017%).
